test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 3 Aug 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: A thief steals a scooter at 1:40 p.m. and drives it at 54 km/h. The theft is discovered at 2:10 p.m. and the owner sets off to chase the thief on another scooter at 72 km/h. At what time will he catch the thief?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed(Thief) = 54km/h

Theif discovered at 2:10 pm

 

Speed(Owner) = 72km/h

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance / Time taken

**Solution:**

Relative speed = 72 - 54 = 18km/h

In one hour the thief will cover 54km.

In half hour( 1:40pm to 2:10pm) he will cover 54/2= 27km

Now, the owner will reach theif in 27/18 = 3/2 hours = 3/2 x 60 minutes = 90 minutes.

so, 2:10 + 90 minutes = 3:40pm

**Hence, the owner will catch the thief at 3:40 pm.**
